about: Xbox 360: the names of the export ordinals of the system libraries (xam.xex, xboxkrnl.exe): which exported function has which number

source.what: Ordinal names of the console's system libraries, as collected by the community (the XEXLoaderWV Ghidra extension's ImportRenamer by Warranty Voider, emoose and others, from xkelib, free60 and Xenia). Names only. Moved from config/symbols/console_ordinals.json, which it replaces.
